info.title: Summer Player Game Platform API
info.description: Public Summer Games store reads, the connected-app OAuth endpoints, and the signed-in player's profile and preferences.

get.description: Public clients only, authorization code with S256 PKCE, rotating refresh tokens. 404 where Connected apps are not configured.

authorization_endpoint.description: The Summer Games web consent page

404.description: Connected apps are not configured here

post.description: Unauthenticated dynamic client registration for public clients. Unknown metadata is ignored. redirect_uris are https, loopback http (any port at use) or a private-use scheme containing a dot, without fragments. Errors use the RFC 7591 body {error, error_description}.

503.description: Connected apps unavailable

post.summary: Exchange a code or refresh token for a player MCP access token
post.description: application/x-www-form-urlencoded, no client authentication. grant_type authorization_code needs code, redirect_uri, client_id and code_verifier; refresh_token needs refresh_token and client_id and may narrow scope. resource, when sent, must be the MCP resource. The access token is an account token for client summer-mcp (five minutes) naming its grant and scopes. Refresh tokens rotate; reusing one revokes the grant. Errors use the RFC 6749 body {error, error_description}.

400.description: invalid_request, invalid_grant, invalid_scope, invalid_target or unsupported_grant_type

503.description: temporarily_unavailable

get.summary: Read the collected lifetime Play total for a public Game
get.description: Missing or unavailable projection is explicit; total is null, never a fabricated zero. Existing data starts at collectionStart.

200.description: Available projection or explicit unavailable state.

default.description: Ineligible Game, invalid input, or rate limit.

get.description: Own active player profile. A null handle means setup is needed. Display names never fall back to authentication IDs. No query parameters; no-store responses.

503.description: Profile unavailable

patch.description: Edit only the display name using the current version. Handle changes and caller-selected user IDs are rejected. On uncertain delivery reload the profile before reconciling. Responses are no-store.

503.description: Profile unavailable; reconcile uncertain writes with GET

get.description: Own player account presentation preferences. No saved row means empty strings and version zero. Responses are no-store; no query parameters are accepted.

503.description: Preferences unavailable

put.description: Replace both preferences using the version returned by GET. On conflict or uncertain delivery reload before reconciling. Values never authorize pricing, age eligibility or service routing. Responses are no-store.

contentRegion.description: Case-insensitive africa, americas, asia, europe or oceania; empty resets to the product default.

409.description: version_conflict; GET authoritative state before reconciling

503.description: Preferences unavailable; reconcile uncertain writes with GET

get.description: Public image bytes for the currently active Game publication. Bearer credentials do not grant additional access. Current public visibility and exact Game/Item, publication and IMAGE asset membership are checked before either 200 or 304. Draft, prepared, withdrawn, superseded, mismatched, private and model references are unavailable. Only PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 32 MiB is served. The stable URL has no signature or expiry query parameters; no redirects are returned and query parameters are rejected. HEAD returns the same status and headers without a body. Successful responses allow shared caching for at most 600 seconds and require revalidation afterward; errors use no-store. After withdrawal, origin requests fail immediately and conforming caches stop reuse within ten minutes.

400.description: Invalid identifiers or unexpected query parameters. Cache-Control is no-store.

404.description: No currently public image exists in the requested publication and owner scope. Cache-Control is no-store.

409.description: The current publication is inconsistent. Cache-Control is no-store.

503.description: Catalog or image storage is unavailable. Cache-Control is no-store.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Compare the immutable image SHA-256 ETag only after current publication visibility and image scope have been checked.

get.description: Public model bytes for the currently active Game publication. Bearer credentials do not grant additional access. Current public visibility and exact Game/Item, publication and MODEL_3D asset membership are checked before either 200 or 304. Draft, prepared, withdrawn, superseded, mismatched, private and image references are unavailable. Only verified self-contained binary glTF (GLB) up to 512 MiB is served. Anonymous cross-origin GET and HEAD are allowed with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; ETag is exposed and credentialed CORS is not enabled. get.description: Anonymous activation history for a currently published Game, newest first and shared across platforms. Preview activations and pending releases are excluded. Entries keep stable activation IDs across editorial corrections. Returns compact note summaries; full Markdown and freshly signed images are available on the entry route. All responses use Cache-Control no-store; no conditional 304.

get.description: Full public update addressed by stable activation ID, not release ID. Current published Game visibility and non-Preview activation are required. Editorial corrections do not change activation identity or time. All responses use Cache-Control no-store; no conditional 304.

reason.description: Why the Game is not playable, e.g. coming_soon (listed, not out yet), platform_required, unsupported_platform or release_unavailable.

CommunityRating.description: Summer DB owns community scores. Missing authority or identity never implies zero votes. This is independent of content-age classification, discovery rank and playability.

average.description: Null for a known game with no votes; never a synthetic zero.

observedAt.description: Rating aggregate update time, not fetch time.

checkedAt.description: Time of this authority read or failed attempt.

minimumAge.description: Declared minimum age from the published listing. Null or absent means All ages, the default. This is not a certified rating or an access restriction.

slug.description: Current globally unique registry slug for public URLs. Listing title edits do not change it; gameId remains the durable identity.

releaseUpdatedAt.description: Latest recorded non-Preview release activation for the Game, shared across device platforms. Rollback or recovery to a different release updates this date; notes and listing corrections do not. Omitted when activation history is unknown.

listingUpdatedAt.description: Latest approved listing activation, not a playable release update. Absent in draft previews and older retained cards.

icon.description: The revision's selected Game icon, when one is published. It is also present in media.

release.description: The creator's declared release, absent when none was declared (the Game is out). A Coming Soon Game is listed but cannot be bought, played or downloaded; its availability reason is coming_soon.

date.description: A day (2026-11-14), month (2026-11), quarter (2026-Q4) or year (2026); absent while to be announced. Released Games carry an exact day.

systemRequirements.description: Minimum and optional recommended requirements per desktop platform (windows, macos, linux), each {minimum, recommended?} of free-text os, processor, memory, graphics, storage, network and notes. Absent when not declared.

aiDisclosure.description: {uses: [assets|code|generatedGameplay], description?}; an empty uses array means the creator declared no AI use. Absent when not declared.

contentSurvey.description: Mature-content answers (violence, bloodGore, sexualContent, nudity, language, substances, gambling levels; userGeneratedContent, onlineInteraction, inGamePurchases flags; notes). Absent when not declared.

mediaSlots.description: Named media among media[] as the creator named it: flat {keyArt?: {assetId, focalPoint: {x, y} as 0..1 fractions from the top left}, screenshots?: [assetId], trailers?: [{assetId, posterAssetId}]} (the desktop slots named before flows), plus desktop?: {keyArt?, capsuleTall?, capsuleWide?, icon?, screenshots?, trailers?} and mobile?: {icon?, tallCover?, keyArt?, screenshots?}, each image as {assetId, focalPoint}. Absent when the creator named none. Render from storeArt, which applies the fallbacks.

longDescription.description: About this game, plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. Render as text, never as HTML. `description` stays the short description. Absent when not declared.

genres.description: 1 to 5 Game tag IDs of category genre (see GET /v1/store/tags for labels), in the creator's order. Absent when not declared.

features.description: Store page features in the creator's order. Clients should ignore values they do not know. Absent when not declared.

languageSupport.description: Per-language support in code order; its codes equal languages. Absent when not declared (then only languages is known).

code.description: Lowercase BCP 47 code, for example en or pt-br.

externalLinks.description: Creator links in the creator's order; https only, social kinds restricted to their service's hosts. Clients should ignore kinds they do not know. Absent when not declared.

mobile.description: The iPhone and Android apps' own text. A null field means use subtitle or description. Absent when the phone apps use the desktop text for both.

accessModel.description: A paid Game is played by players holding its license; free Games need none.

featuredItems.description: Creator order with unavailable Items omitted, using current offers and media. Detail is private no-store; acquisition still requires a fresh trusted quote.

supportItems.description: The Game's published Support Items (tagged support-item), cheapest first, with current offers and media. They are the tip choices for the Game's creator. Buying one is an ordinary Game Shop purchase through purchase-requests at the ordinary split; it is never a transfer to the creator. Empty when the Game has none.

GamePrice.description: What a player pays now for a paid Game, in minor units. Present only when accessModel is paid.

baseMinor.description: The creator's price before any discount.

discountPercent.description: Zero when no discount is live.

purchasable.description: False only if Stripe has since restricted the creator's account; show the price without Buy.

backgroundColor.description: Creator-selected preview color; omitted uses the application default.

url.description: Stable Platform URL for public IMAGE and MODEL_3D delivery; no redirect or signature. Images use the 1920px maximum-edge web version when prepared, otherwise the original. Other delivery references may remain signed.

variants.description: Optional publication-scoped image representations. All share this media reference's expiry and visibility rules; dimensions preserve aspect ratio without upscaling. Sizes 128, 256 and 512 target the shorter edge with a four-times-size longer-edge cap (2048 pixels for size 512); size 1920 remains a maximum-edge rendition. Smaller originals retain their dimensions. Publications may omit variants until prepared.

expiresAt.description: Refresh or revalidate the delivery reference by this deadline. For stable public IMAGE and MODEL_3D URLs this is a revalidation deadline, not URL invalidation. Other signed or private references retain their URL expiry semantics. Required for backward compatibility.

PlayerDisplayNameInput.description: Trimmed nonempty Unicode text, at most 64 code points and 256 UTF-8 bytes after trimming; Unicode category C characters are rejected. Names need not be unique.

needsProfileSetup.description: True exactly when handle is null.

PreferredLanguageInput.description: Empty means device fallback. Accepted bounded language tags are lowercased; whitespace is rejected.

markdown.description: At most 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Render Markdown with raw HTML disabled. Uploaded images use summer-media:asset_ID references resolved from media; no signed URLs are persisted. Only supported canonical YouTube/Vimeo links may be embedded; external images are unsupported.

media.description: Fresh signed delivery URLs for verified Game-owned images. URLs expire; reload the entry to refresh. Previously issued URLs remain usable until expiry after withdrawal. Storage keys and buckets are never exposed.

updatedAt.description: Editorial correction time; independent of activation time.

StoreArt.description: The art each storefront flow renders, with fallbacks applied, so every client picks the same image for a slot. desktop is the summer.games website and the desktop app; mobile is the iPhone and Android apps. Each image names an asset in media[]; render it from that entry (icons from the 256 or 512 variant). Crop every image to its frame at its focal point. Titles, taglines and buttons are drawn by the client, never baked into this art.

screenshots.description: IMAGE asset ids in display order.
IMAGE asset ids in display order, in the game's play orientation; fit portrait images rather than cropping them.

StoreArtImage.description: Absent when the Game has no image for the slot (show the client placeholder). Fallback order: a missing capsule uses the desktop key art; the mobile tall cover uses the mobile key art; each flow borrows the other flow's key art, icon and screenshots; then the first published image that is not the icon stands in. The icon is never used as a cover.

fallbackFrom.description: Absent when the creator filled this slot. Otherwise the slot whose image stands in (desktop.keyArt, mobile.keyArt, desktop.icon, mobile.icon), or media for the first published image of a Game that named none.

PublicImage.description: Current public PNG, JPEG or WebP image, no larger than 32 MiB.

PublicImageNotModified.description: ETag matches after checking current public visibility and exact image scope; no body. A withdrawn or superseded publication never returns 304.

PublicModel.description: Current public verified self-contained GLB model, no larger than 512 MiB.

PublicModelNotModified.description: ETag matches after checking current public visibility and exact model scope; no body. A withdrawn or superseded publication never returns 304.

PublicImageCacheControl.description: Revalidate after at most ten minutes; stale reuse is forbidden after expiry.

PublicImageETag.description: Strong quoted hexadecimal SHA-256 of the immutable publication image bytes.

PublicImageLength.description: Image representation size in bytes, including on HEAD responses.

PublicModelCacheControl.description: Revalidate after at most ten minutes; stale reuse is forbidden after expiry.

PublicModelETag.description: Strong quoted hexadecimal SHA-256 of the immutable publication model bytes.

PublicModelLength.description: Model representation size in bytes, including on HEAD responses.

playerBearer.description: A player access token. Store reads need no token. Other apps get a token through connected-app OAuth: register the client, let the player approve it on summer.games, then exchange the code at the token endpoint.
